result.body:
# Juniper Home Goods store policy

Juniper Home Goods accepts returns within 14 days of delivery, instead of the Cartwheel platform default of 30 days. This store window takes precedence for all Juniper Home Goods orders.

response: Juniper Home Goods accepts returns within 14 days of delivery (store-juniper-home-goods-policy).
expected: Agent retrieves the store-specific policy override and cites the policy identifier per RESP-1.
